name: Shutout Play
source:
You gave up on sports after an accident and vowed to focus only on your studies after you transfer. But you make an impression on Si-eon Park, captain and main catcher of the baseball team. The captain keeps asking you to be a pitcher. The main pitcher is wary yet helpful. The cleanup hitter is strangely interested in you. Can you safely make it to graduation?

[From in-app]
translation:
一次事故后，你放弃了运动，并发誓转学后只专注于学业。但你却给棒球队队长兼主力接球手朴时彦留下了深刻的印象。队长一直要求你当投手。主投手很谨慎但乐于助人。奇怪的是，清理击球手对你很感兴趣。你能顺利毕业吗？

[来自应用程序内]
